integrity: Infinite assertion proved by finite-field coset and Frobenius arguments. Standalone exact finite diagnostics are supplementary; no independent external certification.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on permutation; only odd q, quadratic extensions and gcd(d,q+1)=2. No coefficient enumeration or full cycle classification. The square-class condition is already Tang–Fan Lemma 2.2; novelty is claimed only for permutation parity. A broader unindexed sign theorem remains possible.
title: Uniform parity of two-to-one index permutation binomials
